All relevant dimensions are packed: their brackets appear before the declared identifier.

| Item | Elaborated result and arithmetic |
|---|---|
| 1. `lane_t` | **13 bits** = `payload` 8 + `tag` 4 + `poison` 1. |
| 2. `i_dataflow.data_i` | **39 bits** = `StrbWidth` 3 × `lane_t` 13. |
| 3. One lane FIFO’s `data_q` | **65 bits** = `Depth` 5 × `data_t` (`lane_t`) 13. |
| 4. Its `read_ptr_q` / `write_ptr_q` | **4 bits each** = `$clog2(5) + 1` = 3 + 1. |
| 5. All generated lane-FIFO `q` state requested | **219 bits** = 3 instances × (65 `data_q` + 4 read pointer + 4 write pointer) = 3 × 73. |
| 6. `i_packet_fifo.fifo_i.mem_q` | **195 bits** = `FifoDepth` 5 × `beat_t` 39 = 5 × 3 × 13. |
| 7. `status_cnt_q` and `usage_o` | **3 bits each**. `cnt_width(5) = idx_width(6) = $clog2(6) = 3`; therefore both are `[2:0]`. |
| 8. Does `flush_i` alone clear `mem_q`? | **No.** It clears pointers/count, not memory. `clr_i` or asynchronous reset is needed to reset `mem_q`. |

`lane_t` is a 13-bit packed struct ([integration.sv:3](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/integration.sv:3)). `beat_t` adds packed `[2:0]`, making it 39 bits ([integration.sv:8](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/integration.sv:8)). The dataflow instance sets `BufferDepth=5`, `StrbWidth=3`, and `byte_t=lane_t` ([integration.sv:31](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/integration.sv:31)). Its generate loop therefore creates:

`i_dataflow.gen_fifo_buffer[0..2].i_passthrough_stream_fifo`

Each receives `Depth=5` and `data_t=lane_t` ([idma_dataflow_element.sv:35](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/src/backend/idma_dataflow_element.sv:35)). The FIFO declares its 65-bit packed `data_q` and 4-bit pointers at [cc_passthrough_stream_fifo.sv:49](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_passthrough_stream_fifo.sv:49), [cc_passthrough_stream_fifo.sv:52](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_passthrough_stream_fifo.sv:52), and [cc_passthrough_stream_fifo.sv:56](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_passthrough_stream_fifo.sv:56).

For the packet FIFO, `Depth=5`, `FallThrough=1`, and `data_t=beat_t` propagate from the integration ([integration.sv:39](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/integration.sv:39)) through `cc_stream_fifo` into `fifo_i` ([cc_stream_fifo.sv:50](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_stream_fifo.sv:50)). `DataWidth` is not overridden, so it remains **32** in both modules; however, it does not make storage 32 bits because explicit `data_t=beat_t` overrides the default `logic [DataWidth-1:0]` type ([cc_stream_fifo.sv:17](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_stream_fifo.sv:17)). Thus `mem_q` is five packed 39-bit beats, not five 32-bit words ([cc_fifo.sv:43](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_fifo.sv:43), [cc_fifo.sv:53](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_fifo.sv:53)).

For completeness, packet read/write pointers use `idx_width(5) = $clog2(5) = 3`, while the count uses `cnt_width(5) = idx_width(6) = 3` ([cc_pkg.sv:43](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_pkg.sv:43)). `status_cnt_q` drives `usage_o` directly ([cc_fifo.sv:51](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_fifo.sv:51), [cc_fifo.sv:55](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_fifo.sv:55)).

On reset behavior: `flush_packet_i` reaches `fifo_i.flush_i`, and `clear_packet_i` reaches `fifo_i.clr_i` ([integration.sv:42](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/integration.sv:42)). `cc_fifo` forms `clr_or_flush` for the read pointer, write pointer, and count only; all three synchronously clear on `posedge clk_i` when either input is asserted ([cc_fifo.sv:121](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_fifo.sv:121)). In contrast, the `mem_q` macro has clear argument `clr_i`, not `clr_or_flush` ([cc_fifo.sv:126](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_fifo.sv:126)).

The macro is `always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni)`: `rst_ni` is asynchronous active-low; `clr_i` is synchronous active-high and takes priority over a normal memory load ([registers.svh:190](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/include/common_cells/registers.svh:190)). Therefore, with `rst_ni=1` and `clr_i=0`, `flush_i=1` makes the FIFO logically empty but leaves stale `mem_q` contents intact, apart from any independently enabled normal write that cycle. `clr_i=1` instead resets the whole 195-bit memory to `{5{beat_t'('0)}}` on the next rising clock edge.
